QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_53

question.text: Non-negotiable warehouse receipts used for commodity delivery settlement must be:

answer.text: Electronically registered to facilitate settlement through the Clearing Corporation
Valid only for 30 days from issuance

explanation.text: The Logic: Warehouse receipts that are not negotiable need to be electronically registered so that settlement can be facilitated through the Clearing Corporation. Approved repositories for this electronic registration include NERL and CDSL. The Trap: Paper-only issuance, any private warehouse, or a 30-day validity cap do not reflect the source position; the focus is electronic registration via approved commodity repositories. Note: Negotiable Warehouse Receipts can be in paper or electronic form; the electronic-registration requirement here is specifically tied to non-negotiable receipts being settled through the Clearing Corporation.
